asOf: 2026 (NGA letter to the Rhode Island Senate on H 7127)
about: Item veto availability and scope, with exact override fractions and reduction powers drawn from the dated repository constitutional research. Detail tags remain estimated where the research mixes primary text, secondary summaries, and unresolved qualifications. No missing legal qualification is treated as verified.

nga2026.title: National Governors Association letter on line-item veto (44 states; six without)
